name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students (Class IX & X)

raw.catalogue_text: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students (Class IX & X) | Provider: Education Section | Academic Year: 2026-27 | Type: Scheduled Tribes (ST) | Open: 2026-06-01 | Close: 2026-10-31
raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students (Class IX & X)
Ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
Department: Education Section
Target Classes: Class 9, Class 10
Academic Requirement: Regular, full-time student enrolled in Class 9 or Class 10.
School Type Requirement: Government or government-recognized secondary schools.
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. 250000
Selection Mode: Direct / Merit
Financial Assistance: Consolidated academic allowance and maintenance grant (₹3,000 - ₹6,250 depending on day scholar vs hosteller status). - Rs. 3500 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students (Class IX & X)?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 9, Class 10.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.

eligibility_summary.academic_requirement: Regular, full-time student enrolled in Class 9 or Class 10.

benefits_summary.details: Consolidated academic allowance and maintenance grant (₹3,000 - ₹6,250 depending on day scholar vs hosteller status).

raw.inclusion_rationale: Core tribal education initiative addressing secondary school retention for Class 9 and 10 tribal students.
